provenance: Expected canonical strings were hand-written from the frozen JSON rules (including all U+0000..001F escapes and Unicode code-point key order). Recipe strings use an explicit field-by-field literal layout. Expected UTF-8 SHA-256 values were computed separately with Node.js crypto.createHash, without importing SpatialIdentity.cs or identity.py. Sidecar fixtures were assembled with Node JSON.stringify and independently assigned expected classifications; no classification code under test generated the oracle.
